result.title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
result.summary: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AnchorComplete，在 TRELLIS.2 基础上结合部分点云条件（全局场景 token 与局部空间证据）和米制尺度的由粗到细生成，从稀疏视角的部分点云恢复完整场景网格并保留已观测几何。
